viewModeCaption: General: folds code elements and uses plain language
textSizeCaption: Text grows on every screen; buttons, bars and names on the map canvas keep their size
motionCaptionApp: Change it in System Settings → Accessibility → Display → Reduce motion
motionCaptionWeb: Change it in your computer's system settings
guidesCaption: Opens by itself the first time you visit each screen. Turned off, it opens only from Show again or the guide icon at the map's top right
